Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000465" [decision]: The authentication gateway lives with team Cinder as of 2025-07-01.  (about: Cinder, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000337" [constraint]: The event bus deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC per the change policy.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000333" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000330": INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000326": Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13 during incident INC-2025-011.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000323" [constraint]: The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000286": Joined writes in the product catalog were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000271" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000259": The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down.  (about: flags service, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000245" [constraint]: billing-api can be released on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception.  (about: billing-api)
- memory_id "1000242" [constraint]: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000237": Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens.  (about: Ledger, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000232": After the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000229" [constraint]: Every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000223" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds as follow-up to INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000220": INC-2025-004 was caused by a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000216": Notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000211" [constraint]: The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000193" [constraint]: The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000149": The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down.  (about: Ledger, reports pipeline)
Existing entity names: Cinder, authentication gateway, event bus, Ledger, INC-2025-011, product catalog, notifier, flags service, job scheduler, billing-api, webhooks service, INC-2025-004, reporting service, reports pipeline

Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
